productHealth.awaitingUpstream: Aggregation not yet available upstream. Layout preview only — values will populate once Web ships the productHealth contract.
productHealth.dataSince: Visit-level data is collected from {date}. Earlier windows read N/A; Retention and Churn need twice the selected period of history.

totalNewRegisteredUsers.label: Total New Registered Users
totalNewRegisteredUsers.sublabel: New identified registrations in the selected date range
totalNewRegisteredUsers.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) where registration_completed occurs in the selected date range.

activeUserRate.label: Active User Rate
activeUserRate.formula:
Distinct Active Users / Distinct Users Present in Period × 100.

Present = opened at least one lesson in the selected range (bounces included). Active = had at least one PDF lesson visit in the range with dwell ≥ the selected threshold (default 60s). Dwell is measured per visit, not summed across visits.
activeUserRate.absoluteLabel: {numerator} active users out of {denominator} users who signed in during the period

engagementRate.label: Engagement Rate
engagementRate.formula:
Distinct Engaged Users / Distinct Active Users × 100.

Engaged = Active + asked the chat at least one question in the same period.
engagementRate.absoluteLabel: {numerator} engaged users out of {denominator} active users

retentionRate.label: Retention Rate
retentionRate.formula:
Retained Users / Users Active in the Prior Window × 100.

The prior window has the same length as the selected range (Last 7 days → users Active 14–7 days ago who were Active again in the last 7 days).
retentionRate.absoluteLabel: {numerator} retained users out of {denominator} eligible users

inactiveChurnRate.label: Inactive / Churn Rate
inactiveChurnRate.formula:
Users Active in the Prior Window Who Were Not Active Again / Users Active in the Prior Window × 100.

Same prior window as Retention, so the two add up to 100%. A drop reads as an improvement.
inactiveChurnRate.absoluteLabel: {numerator} churned users out of {denominator} previously active users

pdfScrollUsabilityRate.label: PDF / Scroll Lesson Usability Rate
pdfScrollUsabilityRate.formula:
PDF/Scroll lesson entries with ≥1 scroll event / Total entered PDF/Scroll lesson instances × 100.

Measures meaningful initial use, not completion.
pdfScrollUsabilityRate.absoluteLabel: {numerator} out of {denominator} PDF / scroll lesson instances had a scroll event
